# Choro modifications

- Upstream: <https://github.com/zortax/gpui-terminal>
- Baseline: version 0.1.0, commit `45c63e57181d27c260124a81c7e4b68a6b6e57b0`
- Upstream license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`)

Choro modifies terminal input, rendering, state, and view integration to align
the component with Choro's GPUI dependency graph and application behavior.
Modified Rust files carry a prominent notice pointing to this record.
